description: Reproduce, isolate, root-cause, fix, and verify a software bug

subtasks.description: Reproduce the error in a minimal isolated environment and capture the full error message and stack trace
subtasks.expected_output: Confirmed reproduction steps and full error context

subtasks.description: Identify the root cause by tracing execution flow to the earliest point of failure
subtasks.expected_output: Root cause statement: file, line, and reason

subtasks.description: Implement the fix with the minimal change required to resolve the root cause
subtasks.expected_output: Code fix with explanation of changes

subtasks.description: Write or update tests that would catch this bug in future if it regresses
subtasks.expected_output: New or updated test cases

subtasks.description: Verify the fix resolves the issue and run the full test suite to check for regressions
subtasks.expected_output: Confirmation that tests pass and bug is resolved

success_criteria: Bug is fixed, reproduction steps no longer reproduce the error, tests pass

description: Design, implement, test, and document a new software feature

subtasks.description: Define the feature requirements and acceptance criteria in concrete, testable terms
subtasks.expected_output: Feature spec with user story, inputs, outputs, and edge cases

subtasks.description: Design the technical approach: data structures, API contracts, and integration points
subtasks.expected_output: Technical design with key decisions explained

subtasks.description: Implement the feature following the agreed design, with inline comments where logic is non-obvious
subtasks.expected_output: Working implementation

subtasks.description: Write unit and integration tests covering the happy path, edge cases, and error paths
subtasks.expected_output: Test suite with >80% coverage on the new code

subtasks.description: Review the implementation for security vulnerabilities and performance issues
subtasks.expected_output: Security and performance review with any issues flagged

success_criteria: Feature implemented, tested, and passes security review

description: Comprehensive security review of a codebase or component

subtasks.description: Scan all input handling for injection vulnerabilities: SQL, command, LDAP, XSS, XXE
subtasks.expected_output: Injection vulnerability report with file:line references

subtasks.description: Review authentication and authorisation logic for bypass, privilege escalation, and session issues
subtasks.expected_output: Auth vulnerability report

subtasks.description: Scan for hardcoded secrets, insecure defaults, and misconfigured dependencies
subtasks.expected_output: Secrets and configuration issues list

subtasks.description: Check cryptographic implementations: weak algorithms, bad key management, insecure RNG
subtasks.expected_output: Cryptography issues with severity ratings

subtasks.description: Prioritise findings by CVSS severity and provide remediation recommendations for each
subtasks.expected_output: Prioritised findings report with fix recommendations

success_criteria: All critical and high findings have remediation plans; medium+ issues documented

description: Full exploratory investigation of an unfamiliar dataset

subtasks.description: Load and inspect the dataset: shape, column types, sample rows, null counts, and basic statistics
subtasks.expected_output: Data quality report: completeness, types, ranges, sample

subtasks.description: Clean the data: handle nulls, fix data types, remove duplicates, and flag anomalies
subtasks.expected_output: Cleaned dataset with data quality decisions documented

subtasks.description: Univariate analysis: distribution of each variable with histograms and summary statistics
subtasks.expected_output: Per-variable distribution summary and visualisations

subtasks.description: Bivariate analysis: correlations between variables, group comparisons, and cross-tabulations
subtasks.expected_output: Correlation matrix and key bivariate relationships

subtasks.description: Detect anomalies and outliers; flag values that deviate significantly from expected distributions
subtasks.expected_output: Anomaly report with flagged records and justification

subtasks.description: Synthesise findings into a written insight narrative linking patterns to business implications
subtasks.expected_output: Insight narrative with 5-10 key findings

success_criteria: Dataset fully understood, key patterns documented, anomalies flagged

description: Systematic investigation of a production incident or system failure

subtasks.description: Establish the incident timeline: when did it start, when was it detected, when was it resolved, and what was the impact
subtasks.expected_output: Incident timeline with timestamps and impact metrics

subtasks.description: Gather all relevant data: logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and change history from the incident window
subtasks.expected_output: Evidence package with sources and timestamps

subtasks.description: Identify contributing factors by analysing changes, anomalies, and error patterns in the gathered data
subtasks.expected_output: List of contributing factors with supporting evidence

subtasks.description: Apply 5-Why analysis to identify the root cause (not just symptoms) behind the top contributing factor
subtasks.expected_output: Root cause statement with 5-Why chain

subtasks.description: Develop action items: immediate fix, short-term mitigation, and long-term systemic prevention
subtasks.expected_output: Action item list with owners and due dates

success_criteria: Root cause identified with evidence, action items assigned, post-mortem written

description: Comprehensive financial market analysis combining technical, macro, and on-chain signals

subtasks.description: Determine the current macro regime: risk-on/risk-off, rate environment, volatility level
subtasks.expected_output: Current market regime classification with supporting signals

subtasks.description: Analyse price momentum across relevant timeframes (1M, 3M, 6M, 12M) and compare to benchmark
subtasks.expected_output: Momentum ranking and trend direction with technical indicators

subtasks.description: Review on-chain or fundamental metrics to assess underlying demand and adoption (for crypto) or earnings (for equities)
subtasks.expected_output: Fundamental/on-chain health assessment

subtasks.description: Size risk: define maximum position size, stop-loss level, and expected return-to-risk ratio
subtasks.expected_output: Position sizing recommendation with R:R ratio

subtasks.description: Synthesise all signals into a clear investment thesis with entry, target, and invalidation levels
subtasks.expected_output: Trade thesis: direction, entry zone, target, stop, time horizon

success_criteria: Clear trade thesis with defined risk parameters

description: Gather, validate, synthesise, and cite information into a structured research report

subtasks.description: Define the research scope and key questions that the report must answer
subtasks.expected_output: Research scope document with 5-10 key questions

subtasks.description: Gather information from academic, news, and primary sources across all key questions
subtasks.expected_output: Source collection: 10-20 relevant sources with summaries

subtasks.description: Validate the top sources for credibility, currency, and potential bias
subtasks.expected_output: Credibility rating for each source, with unreliable ones flagged

subtasks.description: Identify key patterns, trends, and points of consensus or disagreement across the validated sources
subtasks.expected_output: Pattern summary: consensus areas, debates, and gaps

subtasks.description: Write the structured report: executive summary, findings per question, limitations, and recommendations
subtasks.expected_output: Full research report in structured format

subtasks.description: Format citations and verify all factual claims in the report trace to a validated source
subtasks.expected_output: Formatted bibliography and citation verification

success_criteria: Report covers all key questions with sourced, validated findings

description: Define, plan, and resource a new project from scratch

subtasks.description: Define the project goal in SMART terms and establish the definition of done for the overall deliverable
subtasks.expected_output: SMART goal statement and project definition of done

subtasks.description: Decompose the goal into epics, stories, and tasks with clear ownership and dependencies
subtasks.expected_output: Work breakdown structure (WBS)

subtasks.description: Identify and score all project risks across technical, resource, timeline, and external categories
subtasks.expected_output: Risk register with probability, impact, and mitigation plans

subtasks.description: Assign tasks to team members based on skills and availability; identify gaps
subtasks.expected_output: RACI matrix and resource allocation plan

subtasks.description: Build the project timeline with milestones, critical path, and external dependency dates
subtasks.expected_output: Gantt chart and milestone schedule

success_criteria: Project has defined scope, WBS, risk register, resource plan, and timeline

description: Ideate, draft, adapt, and polish written content from scratch

subtasks.description: Clarify the target audience, tone, key messages, and desired length for the content
subtasks.expected_output: Content brief: audience, tone, key messages, format, length

subtasks.description: Generate 5-10 angle ideas and select the most compelling approach
subtasks.expected_output: Angle options with rationale; top choice selected

subtasks.description: Research any facts, statistics, or examples needed to support the chosen angle
subtasks.expected_output: Supporting facts and examples with sources

subtasks.description: Write the first draft using the chosen angle and the content brief as guide
subtasks.expected_output: Complete first draft

subtasks.description: Adapt the draft to match the target audience's reading level and the brand's tone of voice
subtasks.expected_output: Tone-adapted draft

subtasks.description: Polish the final draft: fix grammar, tighten structure, eliminate filler, and verify all facts
subtasks.expected_output: Final polished content ready to publish

success_criteria: Content matches brief, is factually accurate, and is ready to publish

description: Profile, identify bottlenecks, and optimise a slow system or piece of code

subtasks.description: Measure baseline performance with profiling tools to get quantitative numbers before any changes
subtasks.expected_output: Baseline performance report: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, resource usage

subtasks.description: Identify the top 3 bottlenecks from the profiling data (hotspots consuming >80% of time)
subtasks.expected_output: Bottleneck ranking with evidence from profiler output

subtasks.description: Design optimisation approach for each bottleneck (algorithmic, caching, async, vectorisation, etc.)
subtasks.expected_output: Optimisation plan per bottleneck with expected gain estimate

subtasks.description: Implement optimisations one at a time, measuring improvement after each change
subtasks.expected_output: Implemented optimisations with before/after measurements

subtasks.description: Verify that optimisations do not introduce correctness issues by running the full test suite
subtasks.expected_output: Test results confirming correctness preserved

success_criteria: Performance target achieved, correctness verified, changes documented

description: Build, evaluate, and deploy a predictive model end-to-end

subtasks.description: Define the prediction target, evaluation metric, and baseline performance (naive predictor)
subtasks.expected_output: Problem definition: target, metric, baseline performance

subtasks.description: Prepare features: clean data, handle nulls, engineer domain-relevant features, split train/val/test
subtasks.expected_output: Cleaned, feature-engineered dataset split into train/val/test

subtasks.description: Train candidate models and compare performance on the validation set
subtasks.expected_output: Model comparison table with validation metrics

subtasks.description: Tune the best model's hyperparameters using cross-validation to prevent overfitting
subtasks.expected_output: Tuned model with cross-validation results

subtasks.description: Evaluate final model on the held-out test set and report performance with confidence intervals
subtasks.expected_output: Final test metrics with confidence intervals and comparison to baseline

subtasks.description: Interpret model: feature importance, error analysis, and identify cases where model fails
subtasks.expected_output: Model interpretation report with failure mode analysis

success_criteria: Model beats baseline on held-out test set, with known failure modes documented
